rank_and_local_injectivity.scope: For any x,y in this convex closed coordinate box, the componentwise mean-value/integral argument gives ||(x-y)-R(Phi(x)-Phi(y))||_infinity <= (1/2)||x-y||_infinity. Hence Phi is injective there and ||x-y||_infinity <= 2||R||_infinity ||Phi(x)-Phi(y)||_infinity. This is local, not global identification over all admissible observations.
